newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from Dirty Disco Recordings' official contact/demo, home, about and catalogue pages plus current Beatport evidence. The canonical first-party form accepts all electronic styles and visibly requests first name, last name, email, a message explaining the release and label fit, a SoundCloud/Dropbox/WeTransfer-style link, a best social link and a choice between the main label and Dirty Disco Imminent. The page rejects unfinished or already-released music and requires the submitter to own or control the rights. No public business email was identified as an authorized alternative to the form. Activity is current: the official site shows active 2026 releases and Beatport lists POIZZONED - Techno Beat on April 10, 2026 and JAXX T - No Escape on March 27, 2026. No field, link, account, CAPTCHA, payment or submission was used.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from Play Records' official demos, contact, privacy, music and about pages. The label accepts completed, unreleased electronic and dance music through the embedded LabelWorx form, rejects unauthorized remixes and covers, requires the submitter to guarantee 100% ownership, asks that uncredited vocal sources be disclosed and permits unmastered demos while requiring a mastered version if selected. The page explicitly says automated or third-party services are ignored, so this route is permanently manual-only. The privacy policy states that demo data is transferred directly to Play Records' LabelWorx account. melody@playrecords.net, simon@playrecords.net, sydney@playrecords.net and admin@playrecords.net are first-party published, syntactically valid and domain-aligned business contacts, but the official contact page forbids using staff email for demos. Activity is current: the official catalogue lists Angelo Maria Calderano - BOOM released July 17, 2026, Spirited scheduled July 24, 2026 and Summer Sessions 2026 Vol. 2 scheduled August 7, 2026. No form field, account, CAPTCHA, email, payment or submission was used.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from HEXAGON's official homepage, about and events pages, current Beatport catalogue evidence and Trackstack's official help and terms. HEXAGON's first-party demo section states that demos are open, that Don Diablo opens every file, and that it seeks House, Bass House and Club Bangers through a Trackstack-powered inbox. Trackstack says tracks can be sent free to public inbox links, while its terms state that most functionality requires an account, users must be over 18, automated use is prohibited and artists grant limited platform and receiver review/promotional-performance licences. The exact embedded HEXAGON inbox fields, login flow and any CAPTCHA were not passively exposed. No public HEXAGON business email was identified as an authorized demo alternative; support@trackstack.app is provider support only. Activity is current: Beatport lists multiple HEXAGON releases through May 15, 2026, and the official site advertises a HEXAGON ADE label night on October 22, 2026. No account, track, form field, CAPTCHA, payment or submission was used.
